## [1.8.0](https://github.com/TorbenStriegel/morphe-patches-custom/compare/v1.7.3...v1.8.0) (2026-11-04)

### ✨ New Features

* **onefootball:** hide match shop and betting promotions ([3af0d18](https://github.com/TorbenStriegel/morphe-patches-custom/commit/3af0d187eaecd7b731201794a1014ffe61810a98))

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Toralarm premium content by forcing the subscription state to active.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes banner and fullscreen (interstitial) ads from the game. Interstitials are reported as shown and closed immediately so the Qt game flow is unaffected. Works without an account.

patches.name: Remove Play Store redirect
patches.description: Removes the PairIP license check that redirects to the Play Store and exits on sideloaded installs.

patches.name: Unlock ntv Plus
patches.description: Unlocks ntv Plus premium features (ad-free, premium content) by forcing the subscription state to active.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, native, app-open and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Hide match FanShop promotions
patches.description: Hides the FanShop product carousel on the match overview.

patches.name: Hide match betting odds
patches.description: Disables bookmaker betting cards and odds on the match overview while retaining match predictions.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Enables premium features: ad-free experience, HD radar and all gated content. Works without an account.

patches.name: Unlock Premium features
patches.description: Unlocks Chargeprice premium features (ad-free, price filters, route planner, favourites, ...) without needing to log in or purchase a subscription.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Park4Night premium (Pro) access, removing all feature gates for offline maps, advanced filters, and publisher content.
